correctness.rationale: On each cell, (D^2+1)e=mu with zero boundary values and Green G_h(s,t)=-sin(min(s,t))*sin(h-max(s,t))/sin h. The kernel sup is tan(h/2)/2 and exact integrated norm is cos(t-h/2)/cos(h/2)-1, maximized at cell midpoint. Antipodal symmetry forces cell mass <=M/2, explaining the sup factor 1/4; L1 sums both antipodal cells with full 2pi measure. For q(x)=|<v,x>| the profile |sin(theta-alpha)| has mu=2delta_alpha+2delta_(alpha+pi), M=4 and maximizes both. Since sum of N gaps is pi, h*>=pi/N with equality only equally spaced. Checked exact trigonometric identities for h=0.3,0.7,1.4,2.1; boundary masses contribute zero to Green cell errors. General all-fan result follows from Green representation, not finite script.
